news.title: SkelPro 2.0: Template Variables, Structure Checks and an MCP Server for AI Agents
news.message:
SkelPro 2.0 is out, with the biggest set of changes since launch:

- Template variables: {{placeholders}}, case helpers and optional files. Turn any project into a template with: skelpro save my-template ./my-app --var projectName=my-app
- Agent-ready projects: new projects start with AGENTS.md and a .skelpro.json manifest. Add them to an existing project with: skelpro init-agents
- skelpro check: catches structure drift in CI or a pre-commit hook.
- MCP server: lets Claude, Cursor and Copilot use your templates. Setup: npx skelpro mcp --print-config
- Agent worktrees: skelpro agents spawn <task> gives each agent its own branch and folder.

Also in this release: security fixes, plus fixes for images in templates, ignored folders and --install.

SkelPro 2.0 requires Node.js 20 or newer. Update with: npm install -g skelpro@latest

 -- The SkelPro Team
